conditions: This is a fix-version claim: the described localtime_r soundness issue affects versions before 0.2.23, and is mitigated starting with this version by refusing to call the unsound path on Linux.
summary: Rust time crate >=0.2.7, <0.2.23 (and 0.1.x) can segfault on unix-like OSes: it calls localtime_r, which reads TZ via getenv without synchronization. If another thread sets an env var concurrently, this can dereference a dangling pointer and crash (CVE-2020-26235, GHSA-wcg3-cvx6-7396). Fixed in 0.2.23: local-offset methods now fail or assume UTC on Linux instead of calling the unsound path.
